title: Primary Four Islamic Religious Education — Term III 2026
summary: A provisional 20-lesson, 40-minute outline based on the NCDC P4 IRE study booklet's topic sequence, including congregational prayer, impurities, early converts, Surat Al-Humazah, Imaan, Surat Al-Falaq and cleanliness. Term III school-reference conflicts are declared as gaps for DOS review.

gaps: The NCDC Primary Four IRE home-study booklet covers Terms I–III without specifying which listed study lessons belong exclusively to Term III. The outline preserves the booklet's topic order; the DOS should confirm term allocation before approval.

The separate Primary Four Term III notes also list Tawhiid (25 prophets, holy books), prayer organisation and Hejira. Their term-specific sequence conflicts with the full NCDC study-booklet sequence. These topics are not falsely represented as extra NCDC lessons; the DOS should reconcile allocation.
The final Hadith cleanliness assessment must use actual exercises from the supplied materials; a full marking key and complete examination paper will be selected during lesson writing.
Only two classroom periods per week are scheduled here because Ledgerly reserves the third for review.
